source: Synthesized 12492 small lights: 6732 irregular land-coverage points fill the country between cities, with the remaining points weighted by original SVG city centers and halo footprints. A smooth approximate eastern ridge reduces density without a hard cutout. Original SVG/20-core metadata is reference only; this is decorative geography, not measured light or terrain data. Off-land samples are rejected, never snapped to coasts or a grid.

provenance.description: Recovered earliest successfully written inline NightMap SVG in this project; original stylized screen coordinates, not measured geography.

sourceSVG.lightMarkup: {lights.map(([cx,cy,r], i) => <g key={i} className="city" style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 170}ms` }}><circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r} className="halo"/><circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r=".8" className="core"/><circle cx={cx+2} cy={cy-1} r=".3" className="core"/></g>)}

registration.method: Three-anchor affine registration from stylized SVG to Seoul, Busan and Jeju; not original measured geography.

sampling.method: 6,732 quieter irregular land-coverage points with a soft eastern ridge; 5,760 preserved SVG-weighted city lights; global land rejection
sampling.size: Independent seeded0.5–1.5 size multipliers, biased toward small points, including anchors.
sampling.thinning: Keep the accepted city field after the original10% reduction; retain11of every20dispersed entries in randomized order. Every retained position,size,brightness and anchor is unchanged.
sampling.brightness: Independent seeded per-point levels: land0.18–1, cities0.22–1; layer means retain the subdued city/land balance. Includes anchor stars.
